## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Risk-on proxies muted: IWM (1W: -1.60% | 1M: -8.30%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND and ARKK (1W: -1.57% | 1M: -4.28%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND; crypto pullback/mean-revert: IBIT (1W: -1.46% | 1M: +4.49%) CORRECTION.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy dominant: XLE (1W: +2.79% | 1M: +7.48%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +7.91% | 1M: +55.60%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND; natural gas mixed with UNG (1W: -1.98% | 1M: +5.00%) CORRECTION.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
CONFIRMED: Energy (XLE and BNO both ABOVE TREND) and rising VXX (VXX (1W: +2.48% | 1M: +24.12%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND) confirm dislocation between commodity-driven strength and broad equity weakness. DIVERGENCE: Broad market and sector breadth (2/11) vs concentrated commodity/energy strength — major tactical divergence to monitor.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor energy exposure (XLE (1W: +2.79% | 1M: +7.48%) ABOVE TREND, BNO (1W: +7.91% | 1M: +55.60%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to broad growth/tech risk (XLK (1W: -1.10% | 1M: -3.51%) BELOW TREND); monitor VXX and TLT for volatility and rate-driven regime shifts.

BEARISH: Materials/Industrials — XLB (1W: -4.49% | 1M: -11.07%) BELOW TREND, XME (1W: -6.70% | 1M: -13.23%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?

BEARISH: Precious metals — GLD (1W: -10.30% | 1M: -10.05%) BELOW TREND, SLV (1W: -15.37% | 1M: -13.36%) BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?  
VXX ~20 (volatility complacency threshold), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit-health pivot), SPY downside watch near prior monthly lows, XLK/XLF spread for growth vs value rotation.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive.  
Energy/commodities showing strength (XLE (1W: +2.79% | 1M: +7.48%) ABOVE TREND; BNO (1W: +7.91% | 1M: +55.60%) ABOVE TREND).  
Key risk: rising volatility vs narrow breadth (VXX (1W: +2.48% | 1M: +24.12%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND) amid broad equity weakness (SPY (1W: -1.80% | 1M: -4.99%) BELOW TREND) — monitor for wider spillover.
